crossRefs.keyword: one cubit for the thickness of the walls

translations.web: He measured the gate from the roof of the one lodge to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, door against door.
translations.bsb: Then he measured the gateway from the roof of one gate chamber to the roof of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from doorway to doorway.
translations.kjv: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.
translations.asv: And he measured the gate from the roof of the one lodge to the roof of the other, a breadth of five and twenty cubits; door against door.
